assignment: Prepare an operational review of a portal reminder pilot for a fictional clinic.
source: The portal group had 16 no-shows in 200 bookings. The phone group had 18 in 150. Staff selected portal users from patients with verified email. Only 40% of bookings in one language group had a verified email, compared with 85% elsewhere. No information on prior attendance or message delivery was collected.

criteria.full: Computes 8% versus 12% and describes the four-percentage-point observed gap.
criteria.partial: Reports a direction or relative claim without correct denominators.

criteria.full: Identifies nonrandom channel assignment and missing prior attendance or delivery as alternative explanations.
criteria.partial: Mentions bias without grounding it in selection or delivery.

criteria.full: Proposes a practical phone or assisted alternative for people without verified email and explains the language disparity.
criteria.partial: Calls the program inclusive without an accessible channel.

criteria.full: Defines a feasible comparison within eligible patients, delivery logging and a disparity check before expansion.
criteria.partial: Suggests a larger pilot without addressing assignment or access.
